subject.title: Control UI: Config upgrade/hardening suggestions should apply changes automatically with before/after diff and user acceptance, not direct users to edit files manually

question: Which Control UI security/auth recommendations may apply config patches, and what confirmation, audit, restart, and allowlist policy must wrap paths such as gateway.controlUi.allowInsecureAuth and gateway.controlUi.allowedOrigins?
rationale: The write primitive exists, but deciding when the UI may turn hardening guidance into executable auth/config changes is a product and security-boundary choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Allowlisted diff-and-accept actions
options.body: Permit a narrow maintainer-approved list of recommendation actions to call config.patch after showing an exact diff, explicit confirmation, audit note, and restart messaging.

options.title: Security paths stay manual
options.body: Allow one-click apply only for non-security convenience settings and keep auth/security recommendations as docs and copyable snippets.

options.title: Defer to protected config approvals
options.body: Wait for the broader owner-approved protected config flow to define shared policy before adding Control UI-specific apply actions.

recommendation.title: Allowlisted diff-and-accept actions
recommendation.body: Permit a narrow maintainer-approved list of recommendation actions to call config.patch after showing an exact diff, explicit confirmation, audit note, and restart messaging.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed overlap across recent Control UI, config safety, and security/auth behavior history.
